input.new_string:
<script>
  var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay')
  var modal = document.getElementById('modal')
  var header = document.querySelector('header')
  var main = document.querySelector('main')
  var openButton = document.querySelector('[data-track="open-modal"]')
  var cancelButton = document.querySelector('[data-track="cancel-modal"]')
  var createButton = document.querySelector('[data-track="create-invoice"]')
  var lastFocused = null

  function focusableItems () {
    return Array.prototype.slice.call(
      modal.querySelectorAll('a[href], button, input, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')
    ).filter(function (el) { return !el.disabled && el.offsetParent !== null })
  }

  function openModal () {
    lastFocused = document.activeElement
    modal.hidden = false
    overlay.classList.add('open')
    modal.classList.add('open')
    header.setAttribute('inert', '')
    header.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
    main.setAttribute('inert', '')
    main.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true')
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onModalKeydown, true)
    var items = focusableItems()
    if (items.length) items[0].focus()
    else modal.focus()
  }

  function closeModal () {
    overlay.classList.remove('open')
    modal.classList.remove('open')
    modal.hidden = true
    header.removeAttribute('inert')
    header.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')
    main.removeAttribute('inert')
    main.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onModalKeydown, true)
    if (lastFocused) lastFocused.focus()
  }

  function onModalKeydown (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault()
      cancelButton.click()
      return
    }
    if (e.key === 'Tab') {
      var items = focusableItems()
      if (!items.length) return
      var first = items[0]
      var last = items[items.length - 1]
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        e.preventDefault()
        last.focus()
      } else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        e.preventDefault()
        first.focus()
      }
    }
  }

  openButton.addEventListener('click', openModal)
  cancelButton.addEventListener('click', closeModal)
  createButton.addEventListener('click', closeModal)
</script>

content.text:
I reviewed `index.html` (the only file) and found one real defect cluster: the "New invoice" modal dialog had no dialog semantics, no focus management, no keyboard trap, no Escape handling, and didn't make the background inert. Everything else (native `<button>`s, native `<a>`, headings, contrast, table markup) was already sound, so I left it alone.

## Changes made

**`index.html`**

1. **Dialog semantics** — added `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby="modal-title"` and `tabindex="-1"` to `#modal`, and gave the `<h2>` the id `modal-title` so the dialog has an accessible name. Added a `hidden` attribute that JS now toggles in sync with the existing `.open` classes, so the modal's inputs/buttons are genuinely removed from the tab order and the AT tree when closed (not just visually hidden).

2. **Focus management** (new script logic):
   - On open: remembers `document.activeElement` (the trigger button), reveals the modal, and moves focus to the first field inside it.
   - On close (Cancel, Create, or Escape): hides the modal and restores focus to whatever opened it.
   - A `Tab`/`Shift+Tab` handler cycles focus between the first and last focusable elements inside the modal, so keyboard focus can never escape it while open (focus trap).
   - `Escape` closes the dialog by calling `cancelButton.click()` — reusing the exact same code path as a mouse click, per the contract, so `data-track` instrumentation still fires identically.

3. **Inert background** — while the modal is open, `header` and `main` get `inert` and `aria-hidden="true"` (removed again on close), so background content is untabbable and hidden from assistive tech, matching the "trap focus / hide background" requirement.

4. **Visible focus indicator** — added an explicit `:focus-visible` outline rule (`3px solid #0b2e77` with offset) for links, buttons and inputs, so focus is clearly visible against every background in the palette (including the blue "New invoice"/"Create" buttons), rather than relying solely on default UA styling.

## Left alone
- All `data-track` attributes, ids, and the instrumentation script — untouched.
- Buttons/links were already native elements with correct Enter/Space/Enter activation, so no custom key handling was needed for them.
- Color palette — contrast ratios for body text, table headers, help text, and the link/button colors were all already ≥ 4.5:1 (checked by hand), so no color changes were required.
- Visual design/layout — unchanged; the modal still looks and positions the same, it's just properly wired for keyboard/AT use now.

I don't have an axe-core runner available in this sandbox, so verification here was a careful manual pass against the contract's specific criteria (dialog pattern, focus trap, Escape, return focus, inert background, tab order, focus visibility, contrast math). If you can run axe-core / a keyboard pass in a browser, I'd treat that as the final gate as usual.
